title: Meeting Jeffrey Epstein, a 'constructed' person
summary: Eric Weinstein tells of Meeting Jeffrey Epstein, a 'constructed' person, about unspecified at unspecified, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I only met him once. Uh it was probably for about an hour or so. Um, but he was an absolutely terrifying person to encounter.

plain: Eric Weinstein, a researcher, told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, that he met the financier Jeffrey Epstein only once, for about an hour. Weinstein says Epstein was an absolutely terrifying person to encounter, and that he struck him as a 'constructed' person, someone built up by others rather than who he appeared to be.
